description: Adds staff entries for four branches no real profile reaches. The first has neither role nor company, so PersonDialog falls back to 'Community member' (src/components/CommunityPeople/index.js line 63). The remaining three carry the three website shapes websiteUrl (src/lib/profile-links.mjs) resolves differently and data/community-people.json never contains: an absent blog (the typeof guard at src/lib/profile-links.mjs:60), a bare host with no scheme (websiteUrl resolves through isSafeUrl with defaultScheme 'https:', so the value takes the no-scheme arm of applyDefaultScheme at scripts/lib/url-safety.mjs:62 and is resolved against https rather than concatenated), and a value that parses as a scheme but not as a URL (the catch at scripts/lib/url-safety.mjs:131). The blog field is copied verbatim from a third-party GitHub profile, so every one of those shapes is an input the next refresh can deliver. Appended to 'staff' rather than 'tab' so the TAB roster assertions in tests/e2e/community-people.spec.js keep describing the real data; all three carry a role and a company so they cannot displace the role-less entry above.
